dct_title_s: Satellite detected water extent over Ringerike Municipality, Viken County, Norway as of 12 August 2023
dct_description_sm: **UNOSAT code FL20230811NOR** This map illustrates satellite-detected water extent as observed from a Pléiades imagery acquired on the 12 August 2023 at 13:31 local time.Within the analysed area of about 16,000 ha, a total of about 255 ha of lands appear to be affected with flood waters. This is a preliminary analysis and has not yet been validated in the field. Please send ground feedback to the United Nations Satellite Centre (UNOSAT).
